name: sidecar-levelchange
description: Two short Conquest levels (Wake, then El Alamein), one round each, two-minute rounds, no bots and two slots: the target for the sidecar's level-change rejoin (features/udp-sidecar/wire.md section 29). With two clients on, the restarted server holds both slots for 180 s, so a client without the reconnect password is refused ServerIsFull and only the previous level's players get back in.
human: No game client. Run the sidecar (`node tools/bf1942-models/sidecar/sidecar.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 --name rejoinA --team 2`) and a filler (`node tools/bf1942-models/sidecar/join.mjs 127.0.0.1:14568 --name filler --stay 0`), so both slots are taken. When the round ends the server restarts for El Alamein. The sidecar should log the reconnect password, the 0x19 drop, the probes, and `back on ... through a reconnect slot`. A keyless `join.mjs` started after the drop should be refused PRServerIsFull until 180 s after the new server came up.
